scope: Read-only preliminary triage of preserved npm audit --omit=dev JSON plus source/lockfile inspection. No upgrades, new audits, network probes or exploit tests.
versionCaveat: Boundary targets leave the reported affected ranges; registry availability and full upstream compatibility were not re-queried. fixAvailable:true does not identify a concrete version. They are investigation targets, not an approved upgrade plan.
runtimeCaveat: CI lock/audit evidence for the candidate is not a live deployment SBOM or proof a package is shipped/exercised in the native bundle.

policy.finding: The current gate enforces max-critical=0; max-high is not set, so a passing audit job can retain high findings.

reachability.classification: reachable middleware; advisory preconditions not reproduced
reachability.finding: Express JSON middleware has an 8mb limit and precedes the v1 origin-auth middleware. Compressed-body trailing-byte behavior was not tested; the size limit is not proof of mitigation.
Compression is attached to v1 after origin authentication with threshold1024. Public gateway-backed catalogue responses use this lane. Premature-close memory retention was not measured.

reachability.classification: dependency present; affected redirect/header path unproved
reachability.finding: Locked path is jimp -> @jimp/plugins -> @jimp/plugin-print -> load-bmfont -> phin -> centra -> follow-redirects. Inspected project code calls Jimp.read(imageBuffer); no project loadFont/print call was found in the bounded backend scope. Neither array-form redirect headers nor custom sensitiveHeaders handling is established. This is not a CardSight/axios chain.
